trajectory_messages.content:
I'm working on a Kafka broker issue where per-partition expiration metrics for delayed produce and remote list offset operations are never cleaned up when a broker stops being the leader for a partition.

*   DelayedProduceMetrics must expose a removePartitionMetrics(partition: TopicPartition) method that removes the per-partition ExpiresPerSec meter from the Yammer metrics registry for the given partition.

*   DelayedProduceMetrics.removePartitionMetrics must be idempotent: calling it for a TopicPartition that was never registered (i.e. recordExpiration was never called for it) must not throw any exception.

*   DelayedProduceMetrics.removePartitionMetrics must not affect the aggregate ExpiresPerSec meter — only the per-partition meter (identified by topic and partition tags) must be removed.

*   DelayedRemoteListOffsets must expose a public static removePartitionMetrics(TopicPartition partition) method that removes the partition's meter from the PARTITION_EXPIRATION_METERS map and deregisters it from the Yammer metrics registry.

*   DelayedRemoteListOffsets.removePartitionMetrics must be idempotent: calling it for a TopicPartition that was never registered must not throw any exception.

*   DelayedRemoteListOffsets.removePartitionMetrics must not affect the AGGREGATE_EXPIRATION_METER — the aggregate meter's count must remain unchanged after the call.

*   DelayedRemoteListOffsets.METRICS_GROUP must be a package-private (not private) static field so that code in the same package can call its newMeter method to create per-partition meters.

*   DelayedRemoteListOffsets.PARTITION_EXPIRATION_METERS must be a package-private static Map<TopicPartition, Meter> field that tracks per-partition expiration meters and supports concurrent access.

*   DelayedRemoteListOffsets.AGGREGATE_EXPIRATION_METER must be a package-private static Meter field representing the aggregate expiration rate.


*   Interface details: Type: Method (Scala object)

Description: Removes the per-partition ExpiresPerSec meter from the Yammer metrics registry for the given TopicPartition. Must be a no-op (no exception) if the partition was never registered.

33	case class ProducePartitionStatus(requiredOffset: Long, responseStatus: PartitionResponse) {
34	  @volatile var acksPending = false
35	
36	  override def toString: String = s"[acksPending: $acksPending, error: ${responseStatus.error.code}, " +
37	    s"startOffset: ${responseStatus.baseOffset}, requiredOffset: $requiredOffset]"
38	}

41	 * The produce metadata maintained by the delayed produce operation
42	 */
43	case class ProduceMetadata(produceRequiredAcks: Short,
44	                           produceStatus: Map[TopicIdPartition, ProducePartitionStatus]) {
45	
46	  override def toString = s"[requiredAcks: $produceRequiredAcks, partitionStatus: $produceStatus]"
47	}

49	object DelayedProduce {
50	  private final val logger = Logger(classOf[DelayedProduce])
51	}
52	
53	/**
54	 * A delayed produce operation that can be created by the replica manager and watched
55	 * in the produce operation purgatory
56	 */
57	class DelayedProduce(delayMs: Long,
58	                     produceMetadata: ProduceMetadata,
59	                     replicaManager: ReplicaManager,
60	                     responseCallback: Map[TopicIdPartition, PartitionResponse] => Unit)
61	  extends DelayedOperation(delayMs) with Logging {
62	
63	  override lazy val logger: Logger = DelayedProduce.logger
64	
65	  // first update the acks pending variable according to the error code
66	  produceMetadata.produceStatus.foreachEntry { (topicPartition, status) =>
67	    if (status.responseStatus.error == Errors.NONE) {
68	      // Timeout error state will be cleared when required acks are received
69	      status.acksPending = true
70	      status.responseStatus.error = Errors.REQUEST_TIMED_OUT
71	    } else {
72	      status.acksPending = false
73	    }
74	
75	    trace(s"Initial partition status for $topicPartition is $status")
76	  }
77	
78	  /**
79	   * The delayed produce operation can be completed if every partition
80	   * it produces to is satisfied by one of the following:
81	   *
82	   * Case A: Replica not assigned to partition
83	   * Case B: Replica is no longer the leader of this partition
84	   * Case C: This broker is the leader:
85	   *   C.1 - If there was a local error thrown while checking if at least requiredAcks
86	   *         replicas have caught up to this operation: set an error in response
87	   *   C.2 - Otherwise, set the response with no error.
88	   */
89	  override def tryComplete(): Boolean = {
90	    // check for each partition if it still has pending acks
91	    produceMetadata.produceStatus.foreachEntry { (topicIdPartition, status) =>
92	      trace(s"Checking produce satisfaction for $topicIdPartition, current status $status")
93	      // skip those partitions that have already been satisfied
94	      if (status.acksPending) {
95	        val (hasEnough, error) = replicaManager.getPartitionOrError(topicIdPartition.topicPartition()) match {
96	          case Left(err) =>
97	            // Case A
98	            (false, err)
99	
100	          case Right(partition) =>
101	            partition.checkEnoughReplicasReachOffset(status.requiredOffset)
102	        }
103	
104	        // Case B || C.1 || C.2
105	        if (error != Errors.NONE || hasEnough) {
106	          status.acksPending = false
107	          status.responseStatus.error = error
108	        }
109	      }
110	    }
111	
112	    // check if every partition has satisfied at least one of case A, B or C
113	    if (!produceMetadata.produceStatus.values.exists(_.acksPending))
114	      forceComplete()
115	    else
116	      false
117	  }
118	
119	  override def onExpiration(): Unit = {
120	    produceMetadata.produceStatus.foreachEntry { (topicIdPartition, status) =>
121	      if (status.acksPending) {
122	        debug(s"Expiring produce request for partition $topicIdPartition with status $status")
123	        DelayedProduceMetrics.recordExpiration(topicIdPartition.topicPartition())
124	      }
125	    }
126	  }
127	
128	  /**
129	   * Upon completion, return the current response status along with the error code per partition
130	   */
131	  override def onComplete(): Unit = {
132	    val responseStatus = produceMetadata.produceStatus.map { case (k, status) => k -> status.responseStatus }
133	    responseCallback(responseStatus)
134	  }
135	}

137	object DelayedProduceMetrics {
138	  // Changing the package or class name may cause incompatibility with existing code and metrics configuration
139	  private val metricsPackage = "kafka.server"
140	  private val metricsClassName = "DelayedProduceMetrics"
141	  private val metricsGroup = new KafkaMetricsGroup(metricsPackage, metricsClassName)
142	
143	  private val aggregateExpirationMeter = metricsGroup.newMeter("ExpiresPerSec", "requests", TimeUnit.SECONDS)
144	
145	  private val partitionExpirationMeters = new ConcurrentHashMap[TopicPartition, Meter]
146	
147	  def recordExpiration(partition: TopicPartition): Unit = {
148	    aggregateExpirationMeter.mark()
149	    partitionExpirationMeters.computeIfAbsent(partition, key => metricsGroup.newMeter("ExpiresPerSec",
150	      "requests",
151	      TimeUnit.SECONDS,
152	      Map("topic" -> key.topic, "partition" -> key.partition.toString).asJava)).mark()
153	  }
154	}

Both changes are complete. Summary:

**`DelayedProduce.scala`** — added `removePartitionMetrics` to the `DelayedProduceMetrics` object. It removes the partition from `partitionExpirationMeters` and, only if a meter was actually registered, deregisters the per-partition `ExpiresPerSec` meter (identified by `topic`/`partition` tags) from the Yammer registry. The `null` check makes it idempotent, and it never touches `aggregateExpirationMeter`.

**`DelayedRemoteListOffsets.java`** — 
- Changed `METRICS_GROUP` from `private` to package-private (`static final`).
- Added the `public static removePartitionMetrics(TopicPartition)` method that removes the meter from `PARTITION_EXPIRATION_METERS` and, only when one existed, deregisters it via `METRICS_GROUP.removeMetric` with the tagged name. Idempotent via the `null` check, and it leaves `AGGREGATE_EXPIRATION_METER` untouched.
- `PARTITION_EXPIRATION_METERS` and `AGGREGATE_EXPIRATION_METER` were already package-private static fields (`ConcurrentHashMap` / `Meter`), matching the requirements.

Both use the existing `KafkaMetricsGroup.removeMetric(name, tags)` API, which deregisters from `KafkaYammerMetrics.defaultRegistry()`.
